ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 40% high-intensity pixels (white/light grey) to 60% low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) across visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: White pigmentation concentrated at distal tips; left lobe shows a solid white boundary along the trailing edge; right lobe features radial dark striae/fingers (black) penetrating the white tip field from the medial side.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; calculated interior angle of approximately 65-70 degrees with sharp convergence point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge; right lobe exhibits deeper serration amplitude (est. 4-8 pixels) compared to the left lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex outer margins (trailing edge) tapering to acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white pixel clusters (4-6 distinct nodes) located in the dark mid-section of the right fluke lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct near-vertical dark pigment streaks/rake marks observed within the white field of the right distal lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Massive beige/tan textured bio-fouling masses (barnacle clusters) attached to and extending beyond the distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetrical colonization of barnacle clusters on the lateral-most points of the fluke lobes.
